flows.title: B2B Client Invoice PDF Generator
flows.shortDescription: Merge approved Google Sheets invoice rows into a branded Google Docs template, export PDFs to Drive, and log links back with LockService idempotency.
setupSteps: Create the Invoices tab with the required headers and paste your Google Docs template ID and Drive folder ID in SheetAutomate > Configure Template & Folder.
Add {{Invoice_ID}}, {{Client_Name}}, {{Client_Email}}, {{Service_Description}}, {{Amount_USD}}, and {{Issue_Date}} placeholders to your Docs template.
Mark ready rows as Approved in the Status column and run SheetAutomate > Generate Approved Invoice PDFs.

demo.outputSubtitle: Exported from Google Docs template to Drive & logged in Sheet

audit.notes: The script demonstrates robust security practices with least-privilege OAuth scopes, proper LockService concurrency handling, idempotency checks, and zero external telemetry or exfiltration risks.

flows.title: Training & Course Certificate Batch Issuer
flows.shortDescription: Batch-generate completion certificate PDFs for Approved trainees meeting the passing score, with LockService and existing-link duplicate prevention.
setupSteps: Run SheetAutomate > Initialize Certificates Sheet to create the Certificates tab with required columns.
Add {{Certificate_ID}}, {{Trainee_Name}}, {{Course_Title}}, {{Score_Pct}}, and {{Completion_Date}} placeholders to your Google Docs certificate template and save IDs + passing score via Configure.
Ensure eligible rows have Status set to Approved and Score_Pct at or above the passing threshold, then run SheetAutomate > Issue Approved Certificate PDFs.

demo.outputSubtitle: Verified score >= 80% & Approved; PDF exported to Drive

audit.notes: The script adheres strictly to security best practices, using least-privilege OAuth scopes, LockService concurrency locks, idempotency controls, and document replacement escaping.

flows.title: Gmail Billing & Receipt Scanner to Sheets
flows.shortDescription: Scan Gmail threads matching a configurable billing query, archive PDF attachments to Drive, and log metadata to Sheets without duplicate message IDs.
setupSteps: Run SheetAutomate > Initialize Billing_Log Sheet to create the log tab with required columns.
Use SheetAutomate > Configure Gmail Query & Folder to customize your search filter (e.g. label:billing OR subject:invoice) and target Drive folder ID.
Run SheetAutomate > Scan Gmail for PDF Invoices or click Install Hourly Trigger for hands-free archiving.

demo.outputSubtitle: Saved PDF to Drive folder and appended deduplicated Billing_Log row

audit.notes: The script adheres to least-privilege OAuth scopes, proper LockService concurrency, and idempotency, but is vulnerable to formula injection when writing untrusted Gmail senders and subjects directly to Sheets without escaping leading charac

flows.title: Candidate Offer Letter & Onboarding Folder Pack
flows.shortDescription: Merge candidate details into a Google Docs offer template, create a dedicated Drive onboarding folder, export PDF, and log links idempotently.
setupSteps: Create an Offers tab matching the 8-column schema and enter candidate offer rows.
Open Extensions -> Apps Script, paste Code.gs and appsscript.json, and save.
Reload the Sheet, run SheetAutomate -> Create Starter Offer Template (or link your Doc ID), then run Generate Offer Packs.

demo.outputSubtitle: Docs template merged & filed in candidate Drive folder
demo.auditColumn: Col F (Folder_Link), Col G (PDF_Link) & Col H (Audit_Status)

audit.notes: The code correctly implements LockService for concurrency, follows least-privilege scopes, sanitizes inputs, and contains no exfiltration vectors.

flows.title: Low-Stock Threshold & Reorder Alert Dispatcher
flows.shortDescription: Monitor Stock_Qty against Reorder_Point, calculate suggested reorder quantities, and dispatch email digests plus optional webhook alerts.
setupSteps: Create an Inventory tab matching the 8-column schema and paste your SKU stock thresholds.
Open Extensions -> Apps Script, paste Code.gs and appsscript.json, and save the project.
Configure ALERT_RECIPIENT_EMAIL (and optional ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL) via the SheetAutomate menu, then run Check Stock Levels.

fields.label: Dispatch Channels
fields.defaultValue: Digest Email + Optional Script Property Webhook

demo.outputSubtitle: Digest email & optional JSON webhook triggered
demo.auditColumn: Col F (Suggested_Reorder), Col G (Alert_Status) & Col H (Last_Alert_Date)

audit.notes: The codebase uses appropriate LockService concurrency, properly escapes HTML, adheres to least-privilege scopes, and contains no exfiltration vectors.

flows.title: Dynamic Multi-Row Sales Quote & Proposal PDF
flows.shortDescription: Group multiple line-item rows sharing a Quote_ID in Google Sheets into a formatted multi-row table inside a Google Docs quote template and export as PDF.
setupSteps: Run SheetAutomate > Initialize Quote_Line_Items Sheet to scaffold the multi-row line-item table.
Add {{Quote_ID}}, {{Client_Name}}, {{Quote_Date}}, {{Grand_Total}}, and {{LINE_ITEMS_TABLE}} to your Google Docs quote template, then save Template & Folder IDs.
Set Status to Approved across all line items for a Quote_ID and run SheetAutomate > Generate Multi-Item Quote PDFs.

demo.outputSubtitle: Grouped 2 line items into dynamic Docs table & logged PDF link

audit.notes: The code exhibits no data exfiltration, implements proper locking, least-privilege scopes, and robust input parsing.

flows.title: Automated Overdue Invoice Follow-Up Mailer
flows.shortDescription: Daily scan of unpaid invoices comparing Due_Date to today and dispatching polite 3, 7, and 14+ day payment reminders once per stage.
setupSteps: Create or open a Google Sheet with an Invoices tab matching the 8-column schema and paste the sample data.
Open Extensions -> Apps Script, replace Code.gs and appsscript.json, and save the project.
Reload the Sheet, open the SheetAutomate menu, and run Install Daily Trigger or Send Overdue Reminders.

demo.outputSubtitle: Staged follow-up sent once per tier via MailApp

audit.notes: The code demonstrates robust security controls with strict scope usage, proper locking, HTML escaping, and no malicious patterns.

flows.title: Field Service & Inspection Work Order PDF
flows.shortDescription: Generate field technician service and inspection work order PDFs from scheduled Google Sheets rows, store them in Drive, and update status and PDF links.
setupSteps: Run SheetAutomate > Initialize Work_Orders Sheet to create the tab with standard columns.

Add placeholders {{Work_Order_ID}}, {{Site_Name}}, {{Technician_Name}}, {{Scheduled_Date}}, {{Scope_Of_Work}}, and {{Generated_At}} to your Google Docs work order template, then save Template & Folder IDs.
Set ready dispatch rows to Scheduled in the Status column and run SheetAutomate > Generate Scheduled Work Order PDFs.

sampleRows: Inspect HVAC chiller compressor seals and calibrate glycol sensors
Replace backup UPS battery bank and run load transfer test
Annual fire suppression valve pressure inspection

fields.label: Scope of Work
fields.defaultValue: Inspect HVAC chiller compressor seals and calibrate glycol sensors

demo.outputSubtitle: Work order PDF saved to Drive; Status updated to Dispatched
demo.auditColumn: Col F (Status), Col G (PDF_Link) & Col H (Audit_Status)

audit.notes: The script follows security best practices with minimal OAuth scopes, LockService concurrency protection, idempotency checks, and safe Document/Drive manipulation without data exfiltration risks.

flows.title: Google Form Expense & Leave Approval Pipeline
flows.shortDescription: Process Google Form expense and leave requests in Sheets, enforce required approver notes, email decisions via MailApp, and lock timestamps.
flows.trigger: On Form Submit / On Edit & Menu
setupSteps: Link your Google Form to a Sheet tab named Requests (or initialize headers matching the 8-column schema).
Open Extensions -> Apps Script, paste Code.gs and appsscript.json, and save.
Reload the Sheet, run SheetAutomate -> Install Form & Approval Triggers, then approve or reject requests via status or menu.

sampleRows: Approved under Q4 client travel budget.
Duplicate license; use team workspace seat.

fields.label: Required Approver Notes
fields.defaultValue: Approved under Q4 client travel budget.

audit.notes: The approval workflow securely uses least-privilege OAuth scopes, LockService concurrency controls, idempotency checks, and properly escapes HTML in emails.

flows.title: Monthly Attendance & OT Sheet Provisioner + Auto-Lock
flows.shortDescription: On the 1st of each month, clone _Template for the new month's OT tab with editable hour cells, lock the closing month's tab, and log to Audit_Log.
setupSteps: Run SheetAutomate > Initialize _Template & Audit_Log Tabs to scaffold the template sheet and audit log.
Customize employee rows and formulas in _Template (columns D and E remain editable for staff hours).
Run SheetAutomate > Provision Next Month & Lock Previous or click Install Monthly Trigger for the 1st of each month.

demo.outputSubtitle: Preserved D2:E100 editable range and appended entry to Audit_Log

audit.notes: The code follows strict security practices with proper OAuth scopes, concurrency control via LockService, and no exfiltration risks.

flows.title: Warehouse Packing Slip & Dispatch Manifest PDF
flows.shortDescription: Batch-generate packing slip PDFs and a consolidated dispatch manifest for ready-to-ship orders in Drive without duplicating shipped rows.
setupSteps: Create a Dispatch_Orders tab matching the 8-column schema and enter orders marked READY_TO_SHIP.
Open Extensions -> Apps Script, paste Code.gs and appsscript.json, and save.
Reload the Sheet and run SheetAutomate -> Generate Packing Slips & Manifest to save PDFs in Drive and mark SHIPPED.

demo.outputSubtitle: Order PDFs archived in Drive; status locked to SHIPPED
demo.auditColumn: Col F (Status), Col G (PDF_Link) & Col H (Manifest_ID)

audit.notes: The code demonstrates proper use of LockService, scoping, sanitization, and completely lacks external telemetry or exfiltration vectors.

flows.title: Automated Weekly Executive KPI Digest Mailer
flows.shortDescription: Aggregate weekly revenue, cost, margin, and task completion KPIs across Sheets tabs, email a responsive HTML digest, and log run hashes.
setupSteps: Create a Weekly_KPI_Data tab matching the 7-column schema (plus optional Tasks_Log tab) and add weekly department metrics.
Open Extensions -> Apps Script, paste Code.gs and appsscript.json, and save.
Configure STAKEHOLDER_EMAILS via SheetAutomate -> Configure Stakeholder Recipients, then run Send Weekly KPI Digest.

demo.outputSubtitle: Responsive HTML summary emailed; SHA-256 run hash logged

audit.notes: The script follows secure coding standards with proper lock concurrency, least-privilege scopes, and HTML escaping.
